Morgan's land fails to provide, leaving him locked in a life or death battle with hunger; Tom's bad luck streak continues into a new season; Rich takes a bruising fall.
German Police dramatically slow the crew down. A Viking Cruise ship invites the men aboard. Things get difficult in Austria.
The crew are denied access to the Danube River in Austria and forced to look for other options. A stranger with a truck is trusted to transport the Jet Ski over the Alps to the Adriatic Sea.

Scott takes a beating in the rough waters of the Adriatic and is showing signs of wanting to call it quits. The men get blown off the waters in Croatia and tour ancient Roman Ruins. Scott is at his breaking point.
Scott quits the team and heads home. Croatian Police force the crew off the water for days. Steven disappears into the Croatian countryside with police and customs officers.
